name: BolBands
summary: This EA trades Bollinger Bands mean reversion signals confirmed by a DEMA trend filter. It buys when a bullish candle crosses above the lower Bollinger Band while DEMA is rising, and sells when a bearish candle crosses below the upper Bollinger Band while DEMA is falling. Positions are closed on opposite band crossing signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带均值回归信号并结合DEMA趋势过滤进行交易。当看涨K线从下穿越下轨且DEMA上升时买入，当看跌K线从上穿越上轨且DEMA下降时卖出。持仓在反向穿越信号出现时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是布林带均值回归，利用价格触及布林带上下轨后回归中轨的统计特性。入场条件：买入需前一根K线收盘价高于下轨且开盘价低于下轨（即K线从下轨下方穿越至上方），同时DEMA连续三期上升确认上升趋势；卖出则相反，需K线从上轨上方穿越至下方且DEMA连续下降。出场条件：多头持仓在K线从上轨上方穿越至下方时平仓，空头持仓在K线从下轨下方穿越至上方时平仓。仓位管理方面，使用固定手数（Lot参数），无动态仓位调整机制。资金管理存在严重缺陷——止损和止盈均设为0，完全依赖信号平仓，无任何风险保护。DEMA使用日线周期而布林带使用30分钟周期，构成多周期确认，但周期差异较大可能导致信号不同步。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on Bollinger Bands mean reversion, exploiting the statistical tendency of prices to return to the middle band after touching the upper or lower bands. Entry conditions: a buy requires the previous bar's close above the lower band and open below it (bullish candle crossing from below the lower band), while DEMA must be rising over three consecutive periods confirming an uptrend; the sell condition is the mirror opposite with a bearish candle crossing below the upper band and DEMA declining. Exit conditions: long positions close when a bearish candle crosses below the upper band, and short positions close when a bullish candle crosses above the lower band. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lot parameter) with no dynamic sizing or risk-based adjustment. Money management has critical flaws—both stop loss and take profit are set to zero, relying entirely on signal-based exits with no risk protection whatsoever. The DEMA uses a daily timeframe while Bollinger Bands use M30, creating a multi-timeframe confirmation, though the large timeframe disparity may cause signal desynchronization.

parameters.name: dema_period
parameters.description: 双指数移动平均线(DEMA)周期

pros: 布林带与DEMA多周期组合提供趋势过滤，减少逆势交易
新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易
K线穿越布林带的入场方式比简单价格比较更可靠，确认了实际突破行为
pros_en: Multi-timeframe combination of Bollinger Bands and DEMA provides trend filtering to reduce counter-trend trades
New bar detection mechanism prevents multiple trades within the same bar
Candle crossing-based entry is more robust than simple price comparison, confirming actual penetration behavior
cons: 止损和止盈均为零，缺乏基本的风险保护，极端行情可能导致巨大亏损
固定手数无动态仓位管理，不适应不同账户规模和波动环境
DEMA使用日线周期而布林带使用30分钟周期，信号时间尺度不匹配可能导致延迟或错误判断
魔术编号设为0，无法区分该EA与其他EA的订单
OrderSend未检查返回值，交易失败无任何处理
cons_en: Zero stop loss and take profit provides no risk protection; extreme market moves can cause catastrophic losses
Fixed lot sizing with no dynamic position management fails to adapt to different account sizes and volatility regimes
DEMA on D1 while Bollinger Bands on M30 creates timeframe mismatch that may cause delayed or incorrect signals
Magic number is set to 0, making it impossible to distinguish this EA's orders from others
OrderSend return value is not checked, leaving trade failures completely unhandled
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，建议止损设在布林带对侧或固定点数，止盈设在布林带中轨附近
将DEMA周期改为与布林带相同或相近的时间框架，避免信号时间尺度错配
添加OrderSend返回值检查和错误处理逻辑，设置非零魔术编号
引入基于ATR的动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和波动率自动调整手数
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters; SL at the opposite band or fixed pips, TP near the middle band
Align DEMA timeframe with Bollinger Bands or use a closer timeframe to avoid signal scale mismatch
Add OrderSend return value checking and error handling, set a non-zero magic number
Introduce ATR-based dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on account equity and volatility

risk_points: 止损为零，无任何下行保护，单笔交易亏损无上限
固定手数不考虑账户风险承受能力
OrderSend无错误处理，交易失败时EA状态不可控
risk_points_en: Zero stop loss provides no downside protection; single trade loss is unbounded
Fixed lot size ignores account risk capacity and market volatility
No OrderSend error handling leaves EA in undefined state on trade failure
